description: Decode Vehicle Identification Numbers to extract make, model, year, body type, engine, manufacturing details, and safety equipment: airbags, stability and braking systems, tire pressure monitoring, and the driver-assistance features VPIC records for the configuration, such as automatic emergency braking, lane keeping, blind spot warning, backup camera, and adaptive cruise control. Pass one VIN, or several as an array or in one string separated by spaces, semicolons, or commas. Partial VINs are accepted, with * for unknown positions; send each partial VIN as its own string or array entry. A call decodes up to 50 VINs; VINs past the first 50 come back in deferredVins to pass back as vin.

modelYear.description: Model year, a whole number, for every VIN without its own ,YYYY. Helps resolve ambiguity for pre-1980 or partial VINs.

anyOf.description: One VIN, or several separated by spaces, semicolons, or commas.
VINs, one per entry or several per entry as in a single string; at most 500 entries.

vin.description: One VIN or several. A VIN is up to 17 letters, digits, or * for an unknown position (e.g., "1HGCM82633A004352"). Separate several VINs in one string with spaces, semicolons, or commas, or list them in an array; a string naming several VINs takes only full 17-character VINs, so send a partial VIN alone. Append ,YYYY to give one VIN its own model year (e.g., "1HGCM82633A004352,2003"). A call decodes up to 50 VINs and takes at most 500; VINs past the first 50 come back in deferredVins.

name: nhtsa_decode_vin

deferredVins.description: VINs past the first 50, in the order sent, present when the call named more VINs than it decodes. Each carries its model year as VIN,YYYY when one applied; pass this list as vin to decode them.

effectiveQuery.description: Number of VINs named and the path taken (single or batch), with how many were decoded and deferred when VINs were deferred.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `empty_vin_list`: The VIN list is empty, or an entry is blank or holds only separators. `invalid_vin`: A VIN holds a character other than a letter A-Z, a digit, or *, runs past 17 characters, or is a partial VIN in a string that names several VINs. `batch_too_large`: The input names more than 500 VINs, or more than 50 on a server set to reject an over-cap batch rather than defer the rest. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Present when VINs past the first 50 were deferred to deferredVins, or when VINs decoded with VPIC warnings (errorCode != 0) — check errorCode/errorText per vehicle.

items.description: Decoded details for a single VIN
